title: Grilled Ukrainian Shrimp with Peppery Skewers
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp skewers, marinated in a zesty Ukrainian-style sauce.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.amount: 10-12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vodka, and lemon juice.
2. Add sliced onion to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread marinated onion mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the onion is caramelized and slightly charred.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh parsley or basil if desired.
